name: Jalon
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jalon is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of the tribe of Judah. He is the son of Esra and belongs to the descendants of Judah. Very little is known about him beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jalon is listed as one of the sons of Esra in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.
